en: A color postcard showing a round, richly ornamented stone mausoleum with arched decorations, circular windows, and a cross on top, photographed from the front at dusk. The structure stands on concentric steps, with a path and trees around it. The back of the postcard has standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp box, plus printed information about the Zsolnay Quarter and Zsolnay Mausoleum in Pécs, Hungary.
